title: Require thread identity in automatic Codex archive barriers
outcome: An automatic archive barrier without a matching thread and Codex home identity grants no automatic unarchive permission; behavioral fixtures use explicit matching identity.
acceptance: Automatic archive authorization refuses a missing or mismatched thread/home identity, and permits a matching automatic barrier.
Existing hand-built fixtures carry the identity needed for their intended behavior, with behavioral negative controls for missing and mismatched identity.
